convert_unit_quaternion_to_rotation_matr: convert a batch of unit quaternions in XYZW format to 3x3 rotation matrices using unitquat_to_rotmat
convert_angle_axis_to_quaternion: convert an Nx3 angle axis tensor to an Nx4 quaternion tensor using angle_axis_to_quaternion
multiply_quaternions: multiply two quaternion tensors of shape (*, 4) together using qmul to get the composed rotation
solve_4d_covariance_scaling_rotation: solve a 4x4 covariance matrix for its scaling factors and left-right quaternion pair using solve_covariance
extract_two_quaternions_from_4d_rotation: decompose a 4D rotation matrix into two normalized quaternions ql and qr using solve_rotation
